summary: Smoke test of freshly imported BDS Marvel repo. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (api root, admin login, auth/me, admin/overview, inquiry create+persist, stays availability, auth/status). Frontend: Home, Projects, Catalogue, Contact, Stays home, Stays search all load with zero JS console errors on live URL. CORS inquiry POST from frontend origin returned 201 and persisted. Admin login via /api/auth/login works and returns role=admin.

observations.no_admin_ui_route: /admin is NOT a registered frontend route; it falls through to a page without a login form. Admin flows are backend-only (/api/auth/login + /api/admin/*). If a UI admin dashboard was expected post-import, main agent should add an /admin route (OwnerDashboard at /owner exists).
observations.no_health_endpoint: There is no /api/health endpoint; /api/ returns {message: 'Hello World'} and is used as the liveness probe in smoke test.

action_items: Optional: add a frontend /admin route (login form + dashboard) if admin UI was intended; backend endpoints are already functional.
Optional: add a lightweight /api/health endpoint for probes/monitoring.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py routes look well-structured with /api prefix; no ObjectId leakage observed in tested endpoints.
server.py is large — consider modularising into routers (auth, stays, admin, inquiries) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ inquiry via /api/inquiries (persisted, not cleaned up — low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh import of BDS Marvel is healthy on preview URL. Smoke confirms backend+frontend integration intact. If admin UI work is requested next, note there is no /admin frontend route today; OwnerDashboard exists at /owner.
